entities.name: UniProt:P53946 (Arp5)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae Actin-related protein 5 (Arp5); 755 aa, 87.56 kDa estimated.
Annotated as a likely transcription-regulation factor through association with the INO80 chromatin-remodeling complex; localized to nucleus.
Swiss-Prot GO annotations include INO80 complex, nucleosome binding, chromatin remodeling, DNA repair, and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
Pfam finds Actin family domains at residues 37–230 and 534–743; no catalytic reaction equation retrieved.
Sequence estimates: pI 5.32, GRAVY −0.832, predicted charge at pH 7 −24; estimates assume unmodified protein.
